content: The second block shows two knowledge-based systems. Lesk$_{ext+emb}$ BIBREF4 is a variant of Lesk algorithm BIBREF2 by calculating the gloss-context overlap of the target word. Babelfy BIBREF6 is a unified graph-based approach which exploits the semantic network structure from BabelNet.
